notes: Reports: Statement, Tax, Compare and Budget vs actual no longer keep the previous report's tile labels or colours. Group rows open that whole group's transactions (new Whole group choices in the Transactions category filter); Uncategorized, unmatched-transfer and no-spend budget rows open their own rows. A slow report can't overwrite the one picked after it. From after To is swapped. The Income report keeps every source row and its tiles show sources and pay sent straight to investments.
